release_notes.en-US: Import from Weava: in the library, pick the .csv file Weava's dashboard export button downloads and every highlight comes over with its note, folder and colour, anchored to its words. Super Simple Highlighter import and merging Restore (0.3.0) and web-PDF highlighting (0.2.0) unchanged.

summary.en-US: Highlight any page, add notes, find it all again. Stored in your browser, no account, exports to Markdown.

description.en-US:
Mark what matters, and keep it.

• Highlight any text on any page — it's there again next visit, anchored to the words so it survives the page changing.
• Click a highlight to change its colour, add a note, or remove it.
• Copy a page's highlights as Markdown (Obsidian, Notion, anything).
• PDFs on the web too: open one in the built-in viewer page from the popup and highlight it like any page.
• Per-site switch: on for the sites you read on; it never runs anywhere else.
• Coming from Weava or Super Simple Highlighter? Import Weava's .csv export or Super Simple's backup file in the library and every highlight comes with you, with its note.

Unlock ($12, once): unlimited sites, six colours, notes and tags, the library — search everything you've kept, export it all, backup and restore (a restore adds, never wipes). One key for every browser; works offline; 14-day refund.

Private by design: no account, no sync server, no data collection. The only request it ever makes is a one-time check when you activate a paid key.

Switching from Weava or Super Simple Highlighter? Side-by-side comparison: https://apps.gankdat.com/weava-alternative.html
